headline: SSX's day glade is real now — and the shelf swap stopped double-drawing
lede: The flagship polish stage folded the ALPINE GLADE woodland into the scenery plan, rebuilt the placeholder system on top of it, and caught a bug that had been hiding in plain pixels: the shelf swap never actually removed its primitives, because it only looked one level deep.

notes.text: #975 shipped (#977): day glade + crash obstacles are shelf models — 18 plan-data conifers per day course, primitives derived 1:1 from the plan, per-model honest degrade when a GLB fails.

The fix no unit test could see: attachShelf scanned only direct children, but the scenery group nests inside the world — every tree and rock double-drew under its GLB since #638. Live probe now reads ph=0 where it used to sit at 360.
Browser gate caught what Node gates couldn't: pixel-level double-draw. New __ssxTest.shelf() probe reports ph/glade/model counts; ssxcheck 334 with two mutants dead.
Advisory pause-stability moved 4→20 — the honest swap now changes pixels the old double-draw had frozen in place. Fixed once (wait-for-shelf before capture), noted, not chased.
